title: Bloom filter: probably yes, definitely no

steps.caption: A Bloom filter: 12 bits, all 0, and 2 hash functions. It answers "definitely not in the set" or "probably in the set".
add("dog"): set the bits at its 2 hash positions [9, 11].
add("owl"): set the bits at its 2 hash positions [3, 11].
add("fox"): set the bits at its 2 hash positions [0, 7].
contains("owl"): bits [3, 11] → probably present (it was added).
contains("emu"): bits [6, 11] → a bit is 0, so definitely NOT present.
contains("bee"): bits [7, 9] → probably present, but it was NEVER added: a false positive.
No false negatives, occasional false positives, tiny memory, no deletions. Used to skip expensive lookups (databases, caches, spell checkers).
